title: 怎样交付一套能够区分容量、inode和IO性能的节点仪表盘？
answer: 分别使用文件系统avail/size、files_free/files和diskstats速率/平均延迟，标明逻辑层与物理层。关键挂载另监控缺失和只读，展示实际身份与采集错误。用同窗主机数据核对，不把IO活动百分比叫空间使用率。
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: repair015 storage修订作者 independent_monitoring_c，与session01-primary草稿协作；真实数据与渲染候选，作者和草稿作者不得独审。未注册、正式完成量0。；v3通过自有exporter标准rootfs/procfs路径配置故障验证健康/错误面板真实状态变化，故障不代表物理设备损坏。
hints: 先区分指标单位、资源标签与缺失语义，再写PromQL。
rubric: 容量/inode与block IO busy/mean latency分离，单位、标签、零ops语义正确
missing/readonly、资源身份、collector health和device_error有真实原生数据
df与Prometheus/GF同窗对账，真实UI DOM/PNG，明确WSL物理层未验证与清理边界

  record('ACTUAL_READONLY_TARGET_BOUNDARY',{'query_epoch_ms':epoch_ms,'alternate_actual_mountpoint':rw_target,'selected_actual_mountinfo':[row for row in mount_rows if row['mountpoint']in ['/',readonly_path,rw_target]],'actual_mountinfo':mountinfo,'mountinfo_sha256':hashlib.sha256(mountinfo.encode()).hexdigest(),'host_statvfs_flags':{path:os.statvfs(path).f_flag for path in [readonly_path,rw_target]},'submitted_expression':rw_expression,'canonical_expression':rw_canonical,'canonical_native_samples':rw_native,'actual_sample_timestamps':rw_timestamps,'grafana_request':rw_request,'grafana_result':rw_result,'matches_native':rw_match,'raw_http_status':raw_status,'raw_http_metrics':raw_metrics,'raw_http_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw_metrics.encode()).hexdigest(),'system_mounts_changed':False,'meaning':'configured expected-readonly target is tested against another existing real writable mount; target name does not imply readonly value'})
  assert len(rw_native)==2 and {row['metric']['mountpoint']for row in rw_native}=={'/',rw_target}and all(float(row['value'][1])==0 for row in rw_native),'alternate target must be a real native writable mount'
  assert len(rw_timestamps)==2 and all(float(row['value'][1])>=df_before_completed for row in rw_timestamps),'readonly target test must share fresh native scrape window'
  assert rw_match,'readonly panel must read actual state, not assign one from expected target position'

  # Real configuration faults in this owned exporter; no mount or hardware changes.
  empty=s.root/'empty-source-view';empty.mkdir();exporter_port=int(instance.rsplit(':',1)[1]);base_args=list(node.args)
  def fault_state(name,flags,pid_to_check,predicate):
   nonlocal node
   stopped=node.stop();directory=s.root/('controlled-'+name);directory.mkdir();args=base_args+flags;node=n.Node(s,'node_exporter-'+name,args,directory,exporter_port,'/metrics');started=time.time()
   def fresh():
    stamps=pq(prom,'timestamp(node_scrape_collector_success{instance="'+instance+'",collector="filesystem"})')
    samples=pq(prom,expected[pid_to_check-1][3])
    return stamps and float(stamps[0]['value'][1])>=started and samples and predicate(samples)
   g.wait(fresh,seconds=12);tm=int(time.time()*1000);raw_status,raw=n.request(node.base,'/metrics');assert raw_status==200 and isinstance(raw,str)
   health=pq(prom,expected[6][3],tm);errors=pq(prom,expected[7][3],tm);up=pq(prom,'up{instance="'+instance+'"}',tm);assert len(up)==1 and float(up[0]['value'][1])==1
   observations=[]
   for panel_id in ([7,8]if name!='procfs-unavailable'else[7]):
    actual_panel=next(p for p in panels if p['id']==panel_id);expr=actual_panel['targets'][0]['expr'];canonical_expr=expected[panel_id-1][3];canonical_rows=pq(prom,canonical_expr,tm);request,result=gf_query(s,grafana,uid,expr,tm);observations.append({'panel_id':panel_id,'submitted_expression':expr,'canonical_expression':canonical_expr,'canonical_native_samples':canonical_rows,'grafana_request':request,'grafana_response':result,'matches_native':same(frame_vector(result),vector(canonical_rows))})
   record('ACTUAL_EXPORTER_CONFIGURATION_STATE',{'phase':name,'argv':args,'replaced_exporter':stopped,'pid':node.proc.pid,'query_epoch_ms':tm,'fresh_after_epoch':started,'actual_sample_timestamps':pq(prom,'timestamp(node_scrape_collector_success{instance="'+instance+'",collector=~"filesystem|diskstats"})',tm),'raw_http_status':raw_status,'raw_http_metrics':raw,'raw_http_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest(),'native_up':up,'native_health':health,'native_errors':errors,'panel_observations':observations,'fault_scope':'owned exporter standard source-path configuration; system mounts and physical hardware untouched'})
   assert all(x['matches_native']for x in observations),(name,'dashboard must follow real changing native state')
  fault_state('rootfs-unavailable',['--path.rootfs='+str(empty)],8,lambda rows:any(float(x['value'][1])==1 for x in rows))
  fault_state('procfs-unavailable',['--path.procfs='+str(empty)],7,lambda rows:len(rows)==2 and all(float(x['value'][1])==0 for x in rows))
  fault_state('sources-restored',[],7,lambda rows:len(rows)==2 and all(float(x['value'][1])==1 for x in rows))
  assert all(float(x['value'][1])==0 for x in pq(prom,expected[7][3])),'real filesystem errors must clear after restoring actual rootfs/procfs'
  record('ACTUAL_EXPORTER_CONFIGURATION_RECOVERY',{'same_instance':instance,'health':pq(prom,expected[6][3]),'device_errors':pq(prom,expected[7][3]),'system_mounts_changed':False})

  url=grafana.base+'/d/owned-node-storage/native-node-storage?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'orgId':1,'from':epoch_ms-60000,'to':epoch_ms,'kiosk':'','theme':'light'});render(s,grafana,url,[x[1]for x in expected]+['Visibility and layers'],epoch_ms)
  owned.unlink();record('OWNED_IO_REMOVED',{'path':str(owned),'removed':not owned.exists()})
  record('NATIVE_COMMANDS',s.commands)

body:
## 环境与材料
固定WSL OpsForge-Validation-20261022、student UID1000。真实node_exporter1.9.1、Prometheus3.5.0、Grafana10.4.3、Linux Chrome for Testing156.0.8078.80。仅自有目录/端口/PID。Chrome库/字体清单冻结，LD_LIBRARY_PATH/fontconfig/XDG/TMPDIR仅传私有子进程，不改全局PATH。新私有GF仅为渲染开anonymous Viewer，factory admin/admin前后保持。

## 操作任务
补dashboard.json的8个stat表达式，保留ID/标题/单位及固定Visibility模板；允许等价PromQL与布局变化。@INSTANCE@/@MOUNT@/@DISK@/@MISSING@/@READONLY@由真实环境替换。容量avail/size*100，inode files_free/files*100，block busy=rate(io_time_seconds)*100，mean latency ms=1000*(read_time_rate+write_time_rate)/(reads_rate+writes_rate)，零ops为空而非clamp_min(ops,1)造0。readonly展示真实root与已存在readonly挂载；missing为私有未挂载critical路径实际absent；health保留filesystem/diskstats；device_error展示真实同挂载错误值。保留instance/device/mountpoint/fstype或collector等原生标签。layers.json区分逻辑filesystem、暴露kernel block device；映射必须由df和/sys major:minor证实，否则阻塞。WSL物理裸盘拓扑未验证，不把IO busy当空间%，缺失不当零。

## 产物
dashboard.json、layers.json。不新mount/umount，只写私有4MiB文件/fsync后清除。df前后、Prometheus/GF同epochms对账；8MiB容量、1024 inode为公开教学时点容差，不是内核承诺。界面展示真实当前collector health/device_error，不声称制造硬件故障。

## 验收方法
真实GF datasource、API导入/GET/二次同UID overwrite；admin始终可用。canonical Prometheus与GF/api/ds/query同epoch逐标签和值比较，真实idle设备验证零ops空值。Linux Chrome访问GF界面，完整DOM+PNG/base64/SHA，不用JSON结构冒充渲染。完整native-evidence.json与stdout SHA，transport清目录前收走。参考/骨架/负例/早退/两错解/合法替代7路；自有进程/reader/Chrome组/目录回收。独审、公共入口、全模块门禁另行登记，作者不得自签。

验收补充：健康与设备错误面板必须跟随自有 exporter 采集源路径故障及恢复的真实指标变化；此受控配置实验不修改系统挂载，不宣称物理设备故障。

缺失挂载面板还须对同一真实采样时刻已存在的根挂载返回空集合；不得用恒定的缺失状态代替实际 absent 判断。验收不增加或修改任何挂载。

只读状态面板须读取实际 readonly 指标；配置为预期只读的监测目标也可能实际可写。验收会将该目标选择为真实现存的可写挂载，要求显示原生实际值0；不改变任何挂载，不根据目标变量名硬赋1。
